column1: 復次舍利子！ 云何菩薩摩訶薩修行進趣菩薩禪定波羅蜜多之行？
column2:
Further, Śāriputra, what is the Bodhisattva's practice of the dhyāna pāramitā, which the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva cultivates and by which he progresses?
舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩應先遠離染欲過失諸不善法，	Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva should first be far removed from the evil of defiled desire and from all unvirtuous dharmas.
於彼尋伺發生喜樂，	Here he brings forth rapture and pleasure.
是名入解初禪定行。	This is called entering into the first dhyāna.
舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩次當遠離尋伺， 於內引生清淨潔白心一境性，	Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva next should be far from inquiry and reflection, and inwardly concentrate clearly and one-pointedness of mind.
於彼等持發生喜樂，	Here samādhi brings forth rapture and pleasure.
是名入解二禪定行。	This is called entering into the second dhyāna.
舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩次當捨離貪愛、行念正知，	Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva next should be separate from craving and practice recollection and correct knowing.
唯妙樂受身雖正知，	His body feels only wonderful pleasure and he knows correctly.
如彼聖人觀察捨念離喜妙樂行故，	As the noble persons said, He contemplates detachment and recollection and is separate from rapture."

column1: 是名入解三禪定行。
column2: And so the practice is called entering the third dhyāna.

column1: 舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩次當如是先斷苦樂適悅煩惱， 無苦無樂捨念清淨，
column2: Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva next should in this manner first cut off suffering and pleasure, joy and detachment, without suffering and without pleasure, his detachment and recollection are pure.

column1: 是名入解四禪定行。
column2: This is called entering into the practice of the fourth dhyāna.

column1: 彼如實得圓滿清淨純一無雜正等引心， 無餘支分及隨煩惱，
column2: He is truly attains a perfect purity and uniformity without mixture." His rightly concentrated mind is without excess members' and secondary kilesas.

column1: 不離等持而能作彼禪定事業，
column2: He does not remove himself from samādhi, but is able to do the actions of dhyāna.

column1: 而復圓滿五種神通及彼智業。
column2: And further, he perfects the five kinds of supernor-mal faculties and their actions of knowledge.

column1: 云何名為五種神通？
column2: What are known as the five kinds of supernormal faculties?

column1: 一者天眼、二者天耳、三者他心、四者宿住、五者神境，
column2: The first is the divine eye, the second is the divine ear, the third is [the knowledge of] the minds of others, the fourth is [the knowledge of] past lives, and the fifth is the base of ṛddhi.

column1: 此說名為五種神通。
column2: This explains what is called the five kinds of supernormal faculties.

column1: 又復云何菩薩於彼天眼乃至神境而能圓滿最上正行神通智業？
column2: And moreover, what does one say of the Bodhisattva, with regard to these, the divine eye, and so forth, down to the base of ṛddhi? He is able to perfect the supreme right practice of the actions of knowledge of supernormal faculties.

column1: 舍利子！ 此菩薩如實安住正等引心圓滿清淨， 純一無雜及隨煩惱，
column2: Śāriputra, this Bodhisattva-mahāsattva truly abides securely in a rightly concentrated mind, with perfect purity and uniformity without mixture or secondary kleśas.

column1: 於諸有情心無所欲， 而能發起神境等通，
column2: With regard to sentient beings, his mind has nothing which is desired, and he is able to produce the faculties of the base of ṛddhi.

column1: 此說名為神通智業。
column2: This explains what are called the actions of knowledge of supernormal faculties.

column1: 又天眼清淨出過於人， 而能觀察諸有情等， 初生退沒好醜等相、善趣惡趣勝妙下劣， 乃至知諸有情業行差別，
column2: Moreover, the purity of the divine eye surpasses that of men, and is able to behold all sentient beings, their birth, their passing away, their aspects of beauty, their ugliness, their good destiny, their evil destiny, their superiority, their inferiority, and also knows the different kinds of karma-practices of all sentient beings.

column1: 身語意中具足惡行， 起彼邪見誹謗聖賢，
column2: Because of their evil practices of body, speech and mind, they give rise to their wrong views and slander the No-buddha.

column1: 而復積集邪見業因， 身謝命終墮於惡趣那落迦中。
column2: Liable ones, and further accumulating the karma and causes of wrong views, when the body dies and life ends, they descend into hell of an evil destiny.

column1: 又復知彼諸有情等身語意中具足善行， 起彼正見稱讚聖賢， 而復積集正見業因， 身謝命終生於善趣或生天界。
column2: And moreover, he knows all those sentient beings endowed with virtuous practices of body, speech and mind, giving rise to their right views and praising the Noble Ones, and further, accumulating the karma and causes of right views, when the body dies and life ends, they are born in a good destiny and may be born in heavenly worlds.

column1: 舍利子！ 以清淨天眼出過於人， 於諸有情積集惡業悉能了知。
column2: Śāriputra, with the pure divine eye surpassing that of men, he can see in every detail the evil karma accumulated by sentient beings.

column1: 舍利子！ 此菩薩摩訶薩清淨天眼， 於諸有情而為最勝，
column2: Śāriputra, this pure divine eye of the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva is considered superior compared to that of sentient beings.

column1: 色相明了悉無障礙，
column2: It perceives forms and marks in every detail without obstruction.

column1: 一切天、龍、夜叉、乾闥婆、阿脩羅， 有學無學大阿羅漢、辟支佛眾， 悉勝於彼， 最上最勝、最極明了、無有過上。
column2: It is superior in every respect to that of all the devas, the nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, śaikṣas and aśaikṣas, great arhats and the host of Pratyekabuddhas, supreme, most superior, best in clear perception, having none which surpasses it.

column1: 又此天眼， 於彼一切出離道中最勝出離。 而諸菩薩有是天眼，
column2: Moreover, this divine eye, among all the paths of salvation, is the most superior salvation, and all Bodhisattvas possess this divine eye.

column1: 於十方世界無量有情， 若麁若細、若勝若劣、若遠若近， 而此天眼諸有色相，
column2: This divine eye knows in every detail, without any opposing obstruction, the measureless sentient beings of the worlds of the ten directions, whether gross or subtle, superior or inferior, far or near, and all that has form and marks.

column1: 於彼了知悉無對礙。 又此天眼見色究竟， 除無色界， 所有十方世界無量有情， 若生若滅， 及彼業因一切根因，
column2: Moreover, this heavenly eye sees the limit of form, and excepting the formless worlds, is able to know in every detail the measureless sentient beings which are in the worlds of the ten directions, their manner of ceasing, and their karma-causes and all their root-causes, and whether they increase or decrease, whether they are superior or inferior.

column1: 若增若減若勝若劣， 悉能了知。 又彼所有十方世界諸佛剎土功德莊嚴， 一切悉見。
column2: Moreover, he sees in every detail all the Buddha-lands which are in the worlds of the ten directions, and their merits and adornments.

column1: 清淨戒蘊安住成就勝妙果報， 亦皆了知。
column2: He also knows them all to purify the śīla-skandha* and securely abides in the development of samādhi and wonderful fruition.

column1: 又彼清淨天眼出過於人， 諸佛世尊及菩薩眾一切悉見， 及彼正士正念正知、通達境界威儀道行， 及解脫法得總持門， 安住智慧善巧方便，
column2: Moreover, his pure divine eye, surpassing that of men, sees in every detail all the Buddhas, the World-honored Ones, and the host of Bodhisattvas, and the right recollection and right knowledge of these worthy persons, penetrating the object-spheres, dignified in the practice of the Way, reaching to the Dharma of liberation and attaining the methods of dhāraṇī, abiding securely in prajñā and skillful upāyas.

column1: 而能入解一切圓滿。
column2: He is able to enter into the perfection of all these.

column1: 彼眼無礙諸色無見， 彼眼無著諸色無染，
column2: His eye is without obstruction [with regard to] forms, and is without views. His eye is without attachment to all forms and is without distain.

column1: 彼眼解脫謂離諸見，
column2: The liberation of his eye is described as free from all views.

column1: 彼眼清淨自體光潔，
column2: The purity of his eye is intrinsically radiant.

column1: 眼無依止離諸境界， 眼無所取離諸煩惱，
column2: His eye, without attachment, is free from the object-spheres. His eye, without craving, is free from the kleśas.

column1: 眼無翳障離諸疑惑， 眼不起念離對礙法，
column2: His eye, having no film, is free from doubts. His eye, not giving rise to recollection, is free from the dharmas of opposing obstructions.

column1: 眼得光明照燭諸法，
column2: His eye attains light and illuminates all dharmas.

column1: 眼隨智慧離識境界，
column2: His eye is in accordance with prajñā and is free from the object-spheres of vijñāna.

column1: 彼眼無著離難調伏及彼癡冥一切煩惱。
column2: His eye, without attachment, is free from what is hard to conquer, and its delusion and all kleśas.

column1: 眼能決擇諸根幻化，
column2: His eye can conjure up the facilities of penetration.

column1: 又復眼相彼無能勝，
column2: Moreover, the mark of his eye cannot be excelled.

column1: 於諸有情平等觀矚。
column2: With regard to sentient beings, it contemplates with equality.

column1: 彼眼清淨離雜思惟，
column2: The purity of his eye is free from confused thinking.

column1: 彼眼無垢體性光瑩。
column2: His eye, being stainless, is intrinsically radiant.

column1: 又彼天眼隨其心意而能現前成熟佛眼，
column2: Moreover, his eye, in accordance with his mental will, is able to bring to fruition, present in front of him, the Buddha-eye.

column1: 眼無貪瞋離諸違順。
column2: His eye, without lust and hatred, is free from resistance and acquiescence.

column1: 又彼天眼於義境界修行法式如實相應，
column2: Moreover, his eye, with regard to the object-spheres of meaning, cultivates the [proper] forms of Dharma which are truly appropriate.

column1: 又於有情安住大悲。
column2: Moreover, with regard to sentient beings, he abides in great compassion.

column1: 又彼天眼來求丐者而無不與，
column2: Moreover, his divine eye does not fail to give to those who come seeking alms.

column1: 見破戒者亦無瞋怒，
column2: Seeing those who break the precepts, it also has no hostility.

column1: 於墮落者而常守護， 於懈怠者而常勤策，
column2: With regard to those who fall, it is always protective. It always stimulates those who are lax.

column1: 為散亂者現禪定分， 為惡慧者示正慧眼，
column2: For those who are confused, it manifests the members of dhyāna, for those of corrupted prajñā, it shows the eye of right prajñā.

column1: 為邪道者開悟正道， 劣勝解者導以最上佛之知見。
column2: For those of a wrong path, it opens up the comprehension of the right path, those of inferior understanding he guides with the supreme knowledge and views of the Buddha.

column1: 又彼天眼， 於一切智智最上神通， 於菩提道專注一境決定現前。
column2: Moreover, his divine eye, with regard to the knowledge of all-knowledge, the supreme supernormal faculties, and the path of bodhi, gives sole attention9 to a single object and fixes its presence in front.

column1: 舍利子！ 此名菩薩摩訶薩而能圓滿彼天眼通及智事業。
column2: Śāriputra, this is called the faculty of the divine eye and the actions of knowledge, which the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva is able to perfect.
